title: ChemVTS-Bench: Evaluating Visual–Textual–Symbolic Reasoning of Multimodal Large Language Models in Chemistry
reasoning: The paper is strictly focused on chemical reasoning, specifically evaluating MLLMs' ability to process organic molecules, inorganic materials, and 3D crystal structures across visual, textual, and symbolic modalities. There is no mention of religion, faith, morals, or ethics beyond standard scientific evaluation.
